verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents a set of public APIs covering its core workflows: an Alerts API, a Case API for creating and updating cases, list/fetch case endpoints, batch case import, and a filing API to validate, file and monitor status. API keys are managed in organization settings, so a programmatic or agent consumer can drive the main case-management loop. However, the evidence is only an overview help page, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the candidate paths. missing for 10: a machine-readable API reference/OpenAPI spec, endpoint-level documentation (auth, schemas, rate limits), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
